policies.title: Turkish ordinary passport holders require an advance Gambian visa
policies.summary: Current Turkish MFA country guidance requires a Gambian visa for ordinary Turkish passport holders, while The Gambia's current government guidance requires advance mission issuance and lists an embassy in Ankara.
conditions: Ordinary (umuma mahsus) Turkish passport, short visit.

Turkish MFA's live country table requires a visa. The Gambia's current government guidance requires visa-subject visitors to use a Gambian diplomatic mission in their country of origin and lists its current embassy in Ankara.
A Turkish Embassy notice dated 5 August 2020 independently directs non-diplomatic Turkish citizens to that Ankara mission. It is supporting route history rather than the currentness anchor.
The generic airport exception applies only where no Gambian diplomatic representative exists and therefore does not replace the Ankara advance route.
The diplomatic 90-day exemption and special/service documents are outside this ordinary-passport policy.

conflicts.explanation: Current Turkish MFA guidance expressly says ordinary Turkish passport holders require a Gambian visa; the Turkish Embassy's live notice gives an advance application route through the Gambian Embassy in Ankara. This directly contradicts the visa-free fallback.
